parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The hybrid cloud cluster ID.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query, in UNIX timestamp (UTC) format. Unit: seconds.

> Only data within the last month can be queried. **StartTime** cannot be earlier than one month before the current time. The query fails if the value is out of the supported range.
> This parameter is optional. Default value: the current time.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.
> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return in a paged query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: **10**, which indicates 10 entries per page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query, in UNIX timestamp (UTC) format. Unit: seconds.

> Only data within the last month can be queried. **StartTime** cannot be earlier than one month before the current time. The query fails if the value is out of the supported range.
> This parameter is optional. Default value: one month before the current time.

parameters.name: StatisticType
parameters.description:
The type of data statistics. Valid values:
- **ip**: IP address statistics.
- **host**: domain name statistics.
- **sensitive_code**: sensitive data type statistics.
- **api**: sensitive data API statistics.
